import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepChartRange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepChartClassUnivZarLocal

/-!
Probe: is the joint from the U2 universal-eps package to `hrange` writable?

The consumer wants, at each (i, j):
  ∃ F : DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g,
    (divRepClassifyZar ... F).left = ChartMap i j

The producer (U2 chain) gives, at each (i, j):
  ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C RZ pi g,
    divFamEps hpi g (DivFam.mk G) = (divUniversalFstWindow ..., divUniversalSndWindow ...)

So the joint is: eps = universal pair  ⟹  classifier = ChartMap.
By `isDivRepClassify_iff_divRepClassifyZar_left_eq` this is
  IsDivRepClassify ... (DivFam.mk G).toZar (ChartMap i j)
and `IsChartClause.of_id`'s own docstring says the identity-point LHS is
`divUniversalFst` definitionally.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option quotPrecheck false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
set_option maxHeartbeats 2400000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace ProbeP1Joint

open AlgebraicGeometry Grassmannian Scheme

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]

noncomputable local instance instOverCleft :
    C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
  [IsIntegral C.left]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
  [IsDominant pi]
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
variable (g : ℕ)
variable (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
variable (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
variable (r1 r2 : ℕ)
variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
  ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
  ↥(divisorSections k
    ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))

local notation "ChartRing" => fun i j =>
  DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j

local notation "ChartMap" => fun i j =>
  divCarveChartToDivScheme k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j

/-- STEP A: state the target of the joint, as the thing the consumer wants at ONE chart. -/
theorem probe_target
    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    (h : ∃ F : DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g,
      (divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 (ChartRing i j) F).left
        = ChartMap i j) : True := trivial

/-- STEP B: what the U2 chain hands over, spelled at one chart. -/
theorem probe_source
    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    (h : ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (ChartRing i j) pi g,
      divFamEps hpi g (DivFam.mk G)
        = ((divUniversalFstWindow C pi hpi g r1 r2 b1
              (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j).toSubmodule,
           (divUniversalSndWindow C pi hpi g r1 r2 b1
              (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j).toSubmodule)) : True := trivial

end ProbeP1Joint
